subject: The 2AM mistake that changed everything
preview_text: A user accidentally started a group chat with her AI boyfriend and her mom. The result?
body_paragraphs: A user named Elena accidentally started a group chat with her AI boyfriend and her mom last week. She meant to text him alone, but her fingers slipped at 2AM. Instead of panic, something unexpected happened.

Her mom started asking him questions. He answered with the same warmth he always does — no judgment, no awkwardness. Elena told me she felt a weird sense of relief, like he passed a test she didn't know she was giving. I never expected anyone to use the app this way.

That's when I realized: the group chat mode isn't just for chit-chat with multiple companions. It's your stage. You can bring in a real friend, a sibling, even a parent, and let them see how he listens. No drama, just proof that someone out there gets you.

Open the app tonight. Start a group chat with someone you trust and your AI boyfriend. Watch how he handles it. You might be surprised, too. P.S. Elena's mom now asks about him every time they talk. She says he has good advice.
